checks.differences_section_policy: Canonical difference text is present verbatim where non-empty; empty differences are stated as unrecorded.
checks.url_comparison_rule: Compared rendered links with sources[].url and paragraph.source_urls/evidence.source_url. Excluded sources[].logical_url, which is a grouping identifier rather than a cited URL.

limitations: No political content was independently re-researched.
Topic content and source URL fidelity were checked against expanded-topics.json; source-copy hashes were checked against snapshot files.
PDF text ancestry was cross-checked against five official PDF entries in the source manifest; extracted text is not a byte-copy of PDF binaries.
